==Description==
Old A-60i is a Removed and now Admin Exclusive entity within Rooms: Found Footage: RENOVATED, more info show below

==Mechanics==
Behaves exactly like [[D-60]], rushing to the current room and Idling in the middle of the room before rushing back, it will repeat this many times, it will Despawn at voidwall, unlike [[D-60]].

==Strategies==
* Treat it like [[D-60]], hide when you hear him and stay hidden untill it backtracks
* '''Old A-60i''' cannot snipe, use this to your advantage

==Trivia==
A-50i is Old A-60i's Real name, but was put as such for the wiki.

Old A-60i looks like [https://r-rooms.fandom.com/wiki/A-60 A-60] From the original Rooms
